protocol.name: helix_window_list_v1

description.summary: the open windows, for the Helix shell

protocol.description: A private protocol between the Helix compositor and the Helix shell, so the shell can show a window switcher and list open windows. In GNOME the shell and the compositor are one process; in Helix they are separate. The global is only advertised to privileged clients (the shell the compositor launched itself).

interface.name: helix_window_list_v1
interface.description: Right after binding, the compositor sends a window event for every open window, topmost first, then a focused event. Later events follow changes. Window ids are never reused.

description.summary: a window appeared, or its app id or title changed
the window with keyboard focus (0: none)

request.name: activate
request.description: Brings the window back if it was minimized. Unknown ids are ignored.
